chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Sandal, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Recite Surah al-Fajr in your obligatory and recommended prayers, for it is the Surah of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him). Whoever recites it will be with al-Husayn (peace be upon him) on the Day of Resurrection in his rank from Paradise.
Surely Allah is Honored and Wise.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for reciting Surah al-Fajr according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith highlights the spiritual affinity between the reciter and Imam al-Husayn (AS), particularly in the context of the Battle of Karbala. It underscores the eschatological reward of sharing the Imam's high rank in Paradise, reinforcing the practice of reciting Surah al-Fajr in both *fara'id* (obligatory) and *nawafil* (voluntary) prayers as a means of drawing closer to the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Sandal from Dawud b. Farqad from Abi Abdillah (a.s.)

who said: “Recite Surah Fajr in your obligatory and recommended prayers. This Surah is related to Imam Husain bin Ali (a.s.). Hence the reciter of this Surah will get a position near Imam Husain (a.s.) in Paradise on the Day of Judgment.
Surely Allah is Honored and Wise.”
